statements.text: Na frase 'Christ Himself bore our sins on the cross', a palavra 'Himself' e um pronome reflexivo que enfatiza o sujeito.
Na frase 'The church has grown significantly since its founding', o tempo verbal e Present Perfect.
Na frase 'Their faith was stronger than ours', 'Their' e pronome possessivo adjetivo e 'ours' e pronome possessivo substantivo.

Na frase 'The psalm that David wrote', 'that' funciona como pronome demonstrativo.
